answer: The crystal test I would run is Proof of unique MOOC certificate set: certificates from three platforms over four years, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. The proof is checked on-chain and the raw secret never leaves the agent, so certificates from three platforms over four years stays private; the ridge is that a leaked database hands the attacker nothing usable. A farm could afford one proof, maybe ten, but the pearl of a hundred is measured in weeks of work and thousands in fees, against a reward that shrinks per head.
